Theoretically, there are an unlimited number of voice alternatives, from what ive seen, most i recorded for one is the mumble, with a total of 29 different voices, so i suppose its a large amount.

comments.author: alta1r
comments.body_html: Question to mr. Liviflame - do you made unity project for this yourself of is there some example/guide/project that i can download or look at to made similar mod. Looked in tutorials/discord etc, nothing that can help even to begin to understand process here. And as far as i understood i cant just edit other sound mods to swap audio and need to do all from scratch. Would much appreciate any help or guidance. Thank you.

comments.author: Liviflame
comments.body_html:
You’d look in the WTT eft-mod-dev discord chat, there is plenty of information and troubleshooting steps in there, along with the author of many other voice mods, and the original voice patcher. Just search the discord for “voice”.

You can look at the Dick Marcinko pack by TurboZoroger, thats what many people use to base their voice mods (what have been created so far, at least.) off of.

you’re not looking to edit sounds, what you need to do is create/rip assets, open unity, and utilize GrooveyPenguinX’s unity tool to add proper tags using his Tagbanks to the voices, and bundle them together. Frankenstein the bundles and references from the dick marcinko pack by replacing the bundles with yours, changing the filenames and whatnot, and seeing if that works for you.

As far as troubleshooting steps, you’re far, FAR better off asking in the discord, there are plenty of folks that actually make the mods that I used to create my own, that are significantly more equipped to answer your questions.

Thanks for looking at my mod!

Infinite loading on the main menu may be a symptom of a mod incompatibility or a version mismatch.

Please ensure that your game and all mods are updated to the latest versions. It may help to send me your mod list and the output on your server command prompt so I can see if I have the same issue on my end.

README.md is just a simple text document file type. You can open it with a text editor, like Notepad. I use it as a changelog for my mod :)
